en.title: Firearm found in 7-year-old student's schoolbag; father says 'I put it there, I forgot'
en.summary: A handgun was discovered in a first-grade student's backpack at a school in Tarsus, Mersin. The weapon was found after a teacher noticed it.

en.title: National boxer Busenaz Sürmeneli wins gold medal
en.summary: Turkish boxer Busenaz Sürmeneli won a gold medal at the 2026 European Boxing Championship held in Bulgaria.

stories.title: Aston Villa maçı öncesi... UEFA'dan Fenerbahçe'ye Guendouzi müjdesi

en.title: UEFA gives Fenerbahçe good news about Guendouzi ahead of Aston Villa match
en.summary: UEFA reduced Matteo Guendouzi's suspension from four matches to three, allowing him to play in Fenerbahçe's upcoming match against Aston Villa.

stories.title: Fenerbahçe’den Matteo Guendouzi açıklaması! UEFA kararını verdi

en.title: Fenerbahçe statement on Matteo Guendouzi! UEFA makes decision
en.summary: Fenerbahçe announced that an appeal to the UEFA Appeals Body regarding a penalty imposed on Matteo Guendouzi has been concluded, allowing him to play in the Aston Villa match.

stories.title: Türkiye okul saldırılarını konuşurken... Öğrencinin çantasında 'tabanca' bulundu: Babası 'Ben koydum' dedi

en.title: Turkey discusses school attacks... Gun found in student's backpack: Father says 'I put it there'
en.summary: A licensed firearm was discovered in the backpack of a seven-year-old first-grade student in Tarsus, Mersin. The detained father admitted he placed the weapon in his son's bag and subsequently forgot about it.

stories.title: Denizli’de elektrikli bisikletiyle inşaat temeline düştü: 80 yaşındaki çiftçi hayatını kaybetti

en.title: Fell into construction foundation with electric bike in Denizli: 80-year-old farmer dies
en.summary: An 80-year-old retired farmer in Sarayköy, Denizli lost control of his electric bike while attempting to park it and fell approximately five meters into a construction foundation, resulting in his death.

stories.title: Elektrikli bisikletiyle inşaat temeline düşen 80 yaşındaki adam öldü

en.title: 80-year-old man who fell into construction foundation with electric bike dies
en.summary: An 80-year-old retired farmer lost control of his electric bike while riding in Sarayköy, Denizli and died from injuries sustained in the fall.

en.title: Investment and fund fraud operation in 12 provinces: 20 detained
en.summary: Police conducted simultaneous operations across 12 provinces centered in Manisa targeting a network accused of investment and fund fraud, resulting in 20 suspects being taken into custody.

en.title: Training aircraft with engine failure makes emergency landing in field
en.summary: A training aircraft registered as TC-AJI operated by a flight school made an emergency landing in a field after experiencing engine failure during a training flight from Istanbul Hezarfen Airport in Tekirdağ.

stories.title: Tekirdağ'da eğitim uçağı tarlaya zorunlu iniş yaptı: Pilotların durumu iyi

en.title: Training aircraft makes emergency landing in field in Tekirdağ: Pilots' condition is good
en.summary: A training aircraft experienced engine failure and made an emergency landing in a field in Tekirdağ's Süleymanpaşa district with no damage, and the two pilots taken to hospital for examination were in good condition.

stories.title: 12 ilde yatırım ve fon vurgunu operasyonu: 20 gözaltı

en.title: Investment and fund fraud operation in 12 provinces: 20 detained
en.summary: Police arrested 20 suspects in simultaneous operations across 12 provinces centered in Manisa for investment and fund fraud, with suspicious transaction volumes exceeding 102 million lira detected in shell company accounts in one day.

en.title: Which investment instruments gained and which lost this week?
en.summary: Investment assets generally declined this week, with the dollar/Turkish lira rising 0.38 percent while BIST 100, gold, and euro/Turkish lira fell. Money market funds provided the highest return among investment funds at 0.66 percent.

en.title: UEFA reduced Guendouzi's 4-match ban
en.summary: UEFA announced that the four-match suspension given to Fenerbahçe's French footballer Matteo Guendouzi was reduced to three matches.

en.title: Stock exchange closed the day with gains
en.summary: The BIST 100 index on Borsa Istanbul closed the day up 0.09 percent at 12,899.35 points.

stories.title: Cumhurbaşkanı Yardımcısı Yılmaz: Yatırımların tamamlanma süresi 3-4 yıla indi

en.title: Vice President Yılmaz: Investment Completion Time Reduced to 3-4 Years
en.summary: Vice President Cevdet Yılmaz stated that the average completion time for investments has been reduced from over 10 years to 3-4 years, and announced plans to complete the Fırat University New Hospital Building within 3 years.
